audience: real estate agents and brokers who manage website leads and listings in IDX Broker

useCases.title: Find new leads and see what they viewed
useCases.text: The AI lists leads filtered by a time window on signup, edit, login or activity, and opens one lead with its last viewed listings and searches.

useCases.title: Review a lead's saved searches, properties and visits
useCases.text: The AI reads a lead's saved property searches, saved properties and website traffic history with date, page and referrer, so you see what the lead wants.

useCases.title: List your featured, sold or off-market listings
useCases.text: The AI lists the account's featured listings with address, price, status and agent, and its sold, pending, off-market and supplemental listings.

useCases.title: Check your MLS feeds and searchable data
useCases.text: The AI lists the approved MLSs, shows when a feed was last downloaded, and lists its search fields and its cities, counties or postal codes.

useCases.title: Add a lead or update an existing one
useCases.text: The AI creates a lead from an email and other fields, or changes fields of an existing lead such as name, phone or status.

useCases.title: Add a note to a lead
useCases.text: The AI reads the existing notes on a lead and adds a new note, for example about a showing request. Notes are visible to the account's agents.
